H. Rept. 119-698 - NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027

119th Congress (2025-2026) | Committee Report | Reported 06/15/2026

The Committee on Armed Services submitted the following report to accompany the bill, which directs the Secretary of Defense to accelerate fielding of fixed counter-unmanned aircraft systems at installations and to develop a strategy for procurement and deployment of small unmanned aircraft systems to tactical units across the military departments.

The committee notes that the threat from small unmanned aircraft systems to domestic and overseas installations has grown, and the bill would require a briefing from each service on its plan to employ commercial off-the-shelf systems, along with an assessment of the authorities needed to mitigate drone incursions near sensitive facilities.

Title II of the bill authorizes research and development funding for autonomous systems, collaborative combat aircraft, and counter-drone technology, and the report describes the committee's oversight expectations for each program of record in the fiscal year 2027 request.

The report also addresses test infrastructure, workforce needs, supply chain security for components, and the interaction of military drone operations with the national airspace, and it directs follow-on reviews from the Government Accountability Office on several of these topics.
